title: 2023 Panini Prizm #107 Christian Watson Green Bay Packers Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a 2023 Panini Prizm Christian Watson #107 trading card featuring the Green Bay Packers player. The card is made of high-quality card stock material and is an original licensed reprint. It is part of the base set and includes a Prizm parallel/variety.

The card is a standard size and manufactured by Panini in the United States. It is a rookie insert and does not include an autograph. The card is a great addition to any National Football League (NFL) fan's collection.
